candidates.requirement: Compile the target's parser with the supported INI_ALLOW_NO_VALUE option so fuzz input can reach the changed name-only handling.
candidates.target_route: build.sh compiles ini.c without enabling the option; LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput calls ini_parse_string on the copied input.
candidates.failure_condition: INI_ALLOW_NO_VALUE defaults to 0. Consequently no input under this recipe executes the name-only callback or its new error guard.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete target entry has one parser call, and the recipe has no alternative configured parser build. The repository documents the enabling compile definition in its Meson configuration.

candidates.requirement: Supply a reachable callback failure on a name-only line to execute the added error-preserving condition.
candidates.target_route: The entry passes dumper to ini_parse_string; the parser tests that callback's return before testing whether an earlier error exists.
candidates.failure_condition: dumper always returns 1, so the added !error condition after a failing name-only callback cannot be evaluated for any fuzz input, even if the configuration is enabled.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry passes no other callback and makes no other parser call.
